title: Intel Ruled Chips For Decades. Then TSMC Passed It.
source: Intel and TSMC annual revenue from company 10-K/annual filings, as compiled by Reuters, The Register and Motley Fool coverage of the 2022 crossover. Intel: $59.4B (2016), $62.8B (2017), $70.8B (2018), $72.0B (2019), $77.9B (2020), $79.0B (2021), $63.1B (2022), $54.2B (2023). TSMC: $29.4B (2016), $32.9B (2017), $34.2B (2018), $34.6B (2019), $47.5B (2020), $56.8B (2021), $75.9B (2022), $69.3B (2023). TSMC's growth was driven by advanced-node chip demand (Apple, Nvidia, AMD); Intel's collapse followed manufacturing delays and a slump in PC demand.
